decision.explanation: The album title 'Holy Smoke' refers to two distinct works by different artists. Source D1S1 explicitly identifies 'Holy Smoke' as the debut album by New Zealand pop singer Gin Wigmore. Source D2S1 explicitly identifies 'Holy Smoke' as the fourth solo studio album by English musician Peter Murphy. Since the question asks for the artist of the album without specifying which version, both distinct valid referents must be included as complementary answers.
